verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents API access for core trace operations: filter, export, share and compare 'via the UI or API' (langsmith-docs-2). It also ships Python, TypeScript, Go and Java SDKs for integration (langsmith-docs-24, langsmith-gh-1), but nothing claims full API parity with the UI. Probes found no published OpenAPI spec at common docs paths (langsmith-probe-3). That leaves the full API surface undocumented in this pack, though it is not a contradiction. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, documented API coverage for dashboards, alerts, annotation queues, rules and Engine, and hands-on corroboration.
